Confidence is a bet.
Calibration keeps score.

Probability Express is not a chat wrapper. Every model returns a typed choice and a full probability distribution through Pollinations’ decision endpoint.

01

Independent dispatch

Every model gets the same train state and hazard. They answer independently, so no model can copy the others.

02

Probability consensus

We average the complete distributions—not just the winning labels—to pick the crew maneuver.

03

Visible resolution

Each maneuver has a published success threshold. A visible d100 roll resolves the train’s fate.

04

Brier-style score

Calibrated confidence earns points. Overconfident misses hurt more than honest uncertainty.
